knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Entry is held until the written method statement and risk assessment are received and checked. A verbal method (option 0) and a promise to write it later (option 2) are not acceptable controls.
An unapproved product change is paused, reviewed by the site lead and recorded before the work continues. Effectiveness (option 0) and letting the contractor decide (option 2) are not controls.

The signed completion record is the audit trail showing what was planned, what was done and any approved variation. It does not replace sign-in (option 0) and does not certify a contractor (option 2).

practicalCriteria: Given a contractor arriving without a written method statement, the learner holds entry and states the documents required before the start; the assessor records the hold and the reason.
Given a sign-in scenario, the learner records the contractor's name, company, arrival time and the staff member signing them in, and gives the occupied-area briefing; the assessor checks each field.
Given a mid-job request to change to an unapproved product, the learner pauses the work, names the site lead as reviewer and records the variation before the work resumes.
The learner completes a completion record with the planned and actual scope and both signature lines, as observed on a supplied scenario.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation record for each practical criterion
Sign-in log entry from the scenario
Variation record and the completed completion record from the scenario
stopWorkCriteria: Learner allows a contractor to start without a written method statement and risk assessment on file
Learner allows a contractor to work before signing in or being briefed
Learner allows an unapproved product or method to be used without site lead review
Learner signs a completion record for work that was not inspected against the agreed scope
